_about: Public-domain S. R. Driver (Samuel Rolles Driver, 1846-1914, Regius Professor of Hebrew at Oxford) for the Word Hoard: 14 books from Internet Archive scans, 1887-1915, among them An Introduction to the Literature of the Old Testament (1891), the ICC Deuteronomy (1895), and his commentaries on Genesis, Exodus, Job, Daniel, Joel and Amos and the Minor Prophets. His Hebrew grammar work, his own Bible translations and the Brown-Driver-Briggs lexicon (already held as a lexicon) are left off. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 23 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
